'''Tim Guzman Part 2-Insert Cards Think Negative''' is a strategy article [[Tim Guzman]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as The Information Broker, under the title ''Part 2-Insert Cards.....Think Negative''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Inserts2.htm Part 2-Insert Cards.....Think Negative], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142046/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Inserts2.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Part 2-Insert
Cards.....Think Negative


When I wrote my other article about Inserts I said to think positive. There
are a lot of cards that fix the problem. Well that's true, there is. I still
believe that you should stay positive,(most of the time). I started to dabble
into the arts of the Dark side, and found out that there is a lot of stuff
to be negative about. For starters how does a bunch of droids end up making
Vader Lose force. What about Eloms, sure their strong against Imperials, but
why Destiny 4? With that they kick butt, plus make you lose force with inserts.
The Dark side has droids and characters that do the same thing against the
likes of Obi-Wan, Luke, and even to Yoda. "Strong in the force am I, but not
that strong". Those words from Yoda must be what I need to reflect on in the
case of Inserts. Another thought is, remember all those cards I mentioned
in my last article, to help stop inserts. Well think of this. If inserts were
never made in the first place, then we wouldn't need those cards at all. Meaning
they could have made other cards. Perhaps cards that have or encourage interaction.
Am I being to negative? I don't mean to. In fact I have been known to play
inserts before. The problem lies with those who abuse them. A problem that
wouldn't be there if insert weren't there. So what's the conclusion of this
negative attitude of mine? Well I don't know, but I do know that playing with
Mains is so much more fun. There I said it, I'm done messing with the dark
side. Yes I know Yoda said,"If once you start down the dark path, forever
will it dominate your destiny." But I hope that's not true. So have fun with
the worlds best CCG.


The
Information Broker
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
